title: What is the Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme?
description: Explore Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme and its benefits. Learn how Emiratisation Gateway facilitates Emirati employment in Dubai, UAE.

breadcrumb.name: What is the Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme?

contentHtml:
Ready to embark on the job market in UAE? As a UAE national, you’ll benefit from several attractive opportunities. Out of them, one is the Nafis Emirati salary support scheme. According to this program, it is launched by the UAE government. The aim behind this initiative is to boost the employment of Emirati nationals in the private sector. The program also provides financial incentives to companies that hire and retain Emirati employees. They have a chance to address the need for a skilled workforce while fostering local talent. So, it’s a win-win situation for both, that is employees and employers

In this guide, we walk you through how the Nafis scheme encourages businesses to create a more inclusive workforce. You’ll also learn how the government is empowering Emiratis. While enhancing their participation in the nation’s evolving labor market. Therefore, let’s move on to details!

Overview of the Nafis Scheme:

A Nafis program is designed to enhance the employment ratios of Emirati nationals. This is within the private sector. It is launched by the UAE government, offering various incentives such as:

  • Salary support
  • Training programs, and
  • Career development resources to encourage businesses to hire and retain Emiratis

The scheme aims to bridge the skills gap in the workforce. It aligns talent with industry needs and promotes economic diversification. Nafis seeks to empower Emiratis by fostering a collaborative approach between the government and private enterprises. This ensures meaningful participation in the dynamic economy of the UAE.

Introducing Emiratisation Gateway:

Unlock a world of opportunities with the Emiratisation Gateway—a transformative platform! The company is designed to connect Emirati talent with thriving businesses. Our mission is to empower Emiratis by providing them with access to valuable resources. They can avail of job opportunities. They can register themselves in tailored training programs that align with industry needs.

If you’re a professional looking to launch your career or a seasoned expert seeking new challenges. Know that, the Emiratisation Gateway is your one-stop hub. Begin your career growth and development here. With us, companies can easily tap into a rich pool of local talent. They can benefit from government incentives aimed at enhancing workforce diversity.

Join us in shaping a brighter future for the UAE! Emiratisation Gateway not just building careers; we’re building a sustainable and prosperous economy.  Take your first step toward success and explore the endless possibilities today!

Understanding the Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme is a pivotal government initiative. It enhances Emirati national’s employment in the private sector. The scheme encourages businesses to hire and retain Emiratis. For this, they offer financial incentives. This in turn addresses workforce shortages and promotes local talent.

This initiative reflects the UAE’s commitment to empowering its citizens. It gives them a chance to foster a diverse force that aligns with the nation’s economic goals.

What is the Nafis Scheme?

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme is a government initiative. The program is designed to incentivize the hiring of Emirati nationals in the private sector. They offer financial support to employers, bridging the gap between Emirati talent and job opportunities. The vision is to enhance the local workforce participation.

Objectives of the Scheme:

The primary objective of the Nafis Scheme is to increase Emirati employment in various sectors. This can be achieved by providing salary support to companies that hire nationals.

In addition to this, it seeks to upskill the workforce through training and development programs. It boosts long-term career growth and economic sustainability.

Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must meet specific criteria to benefit from the Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme. This is set by the UAE government. The eligible applicants are:

  • Emirati nationals who are seeking employment in the private sector
  • Businesses looking to hire Emiratis

Companies must also comply with regulations regarding Emiratisation. They must demonstrate a commitment to supporting local talent.

Who Can Benefit?

Emirati job seekers and private sector employers both can benefit from the Nafis Scheme. Emirati nationals looking for job opportunities will receive support through salary incentives.

On the other hand, businesses that hire Emiratis can access:

  • Financial assistance
  • Training programs, and
  • Additional resources to help integrate local talent into their workforce.

Application Process:

The application process for the Nafis Scheme involves several steps. Interested Emiratis and employers must submit an application through the designated portal, providing necessary documentation such as identification, job offers, and proof of compliance with Emiratisation requirements. After review and approval, eligible participants will receive guidance on accessing salary support and related resources to facilitate successful employment outcomes.

Benefits of the Nafis Scheme

The benefits of the Nafis scheme are for both employees and employers. It offers monetary support to the employees in the UAE. The monetary benefits will ultimately reduce the cost of employing Emirati nationals significantly.

For Emirati Employees:

Affiliated with the Nafis Scheme, Emirati employees receive great benefits in the form of monetary support that increases their potential to earn in the private sector. The scheme provides them with training and development opportunities to boost their skills and their employability and aids in career development along with job security in the long term in various sectors.

For Employers:

Under the Nafis Scheme, several benefits are acquired by the employers. Money incentives that consequently reduce the absolute cost of employing Emirati nationals. This scheme promotes diversity in the workforce while simultaneously granting access to skilled talent pools. The companies also enhance their reputation and brand value with commitment towards local employment and part of economic development in UAE.

Implementation and Support

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme implementation requires a collaborative effort. This is in between employers, government entities, and support organizations. The scheme will help encourage effective recruitment through a conducive work environment that encourages the private sector to employ national talents. Employers should therefore embrace this initiative, not just as a way of enjoying financial benefits, but more so as a means of adding value to the economic position of the nation due to this diversification of the workforce.
 Further support for this will be offered through platforms like the Emiratisation Gateway, which serves as a critical resource for job seekers and employers alike. This gateway provides tools and services, including job listings, training, and application assistance, to expedite the connection of Emiratis with potential employers.

Role of Employers:

Employers play a vital role in the Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme. They can actively hire and integrate Emirati nationals into their workforce. Their commitment to mentorship and training enhances employee skills. It also fosters a more diverse work environment.

Support from Emiratisation Gateway:

The Emiratisation Gateway offers essential support to Emirati job seekers and employers. Specifically, one participating in the Nafis Scheme. We provide resources such as:

  • Job listings
  • Training programs, and
  • Application assistance

We streamline the process of connecting local talent with businesses. This in turn promotes successful employment outcomes.

Financial Support Details

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme is an important financial assistance program that would encourage the employment of Emirati nationals in the private sector. Salary subsidies are mainly provided through this support to support the hiring and retention of local talent.

Salary Subsidies:

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme intends to attract more private sector employers to hire Emirati nationals by offering a high level of salary subsidies. The subsidies also target the saving of businesses’ financial costs, in which local talent is to be integrated into such firms.

Duration and Amount:

The salary subsidies last for up to three years. It offers financial support varying based on the position and qualifications of the Emirati employee. Employers can receive monthly subsidies ranging from AED 3,000 to AED 8,000. However, it depends on factors. The factors like the employee’s experience and the nature of the job. It encourages long-term employment and retention.

Impact on the UAE Job Market

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme does indeed have a huge impact on the job market in the UAE by encouraging, through incentives in terms of salaries, the emirate’s nationals to work in the private sector. In other words, businesses are encouraged to make local talent their top priority of hiring, thus addressing unemployment among Emiratis but also improving their participation in the workforce. Alongside this, initiatives like NAFIS Unemployment Benefits further support Emiratis during career transitions, ensuring financial stability while they seek new opportunities.

This also feeds into the broader economic benefits to ensure there is a skilled and diversified labor pool. With Emiratis’ employment in various industries, their experience contributes towards innovation and productivity, which are important precursors to sustainable economic growth. The Nafis Scheme therefore provides support to the goal that the United Arab Emirates has in mind, diversifying the economy and reducing dependency on expatriate labor while ensuring that the employment market becomes more resilient for the future.

Boosting Emirati Employment:

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme plays a crucial role in increasing Emirati employment by incentivizing private sector companies to hire local talent. This initiative not only helps reduce unemployment rates among Emiratis but also fosters a sense of national pride and economic empowerment within the community.

Economic Benefits:

The scheme generates significant economic benefits for the UAE by cultivating a skilled workforce. As more Emiratis enter the job market. Their contributions enhance productivity and innovation. This ultimately drives economic growth and supports the country’s vision for a sustainable economy.

Case Studies and Success Stories

In this blog section, we are going to share the success story of a company that successfully implemented the Nafis Emirati Salary scheme. They considered Emiratis rather than foreign nationals for hiring. This gives them both financial incentives from the government and productive workforce assistance. Success Story: Company X:

Company X, a prominent player in the UAE’s retail sector, successfully integrated the Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme into its hiring strategy. By actively recruiting Emirati nationals, the company not only received financial incentives but also witnessed a boost in workplace morale and productivity as local talent brought fresh perspectives and innovative ideas.

Employee Perspective:

The support provided through the Nafis Scheme has been invaluable. Look from the perspective of Emirati employees at Company X. They appreciate the opportunities for professional growth and development. The sense of community and belonging that comes from working in an environment. The place that values their contributions and invests in their future.

Challenges and Solutions

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme faces several challenges. For instance, it includes:

  • Limited employer awareness about the benefits of hiring Emirati nationals
  • A skills gap that often leaves local candidates unqualified for specific roles

The Emiratisation Gateway provides vital support through training programs to address these issues. It enhances the skills of Emirati job seekers. On the other hand, ensuring they are better equipped for the job market.

Furthermore, it raises awareness among employers about the advantages of the scheme, facilitating connections between businesses and qualified Emiratis. This fosters a more inclusive and engaged workforce.

Common Challenges:

Despite the positive impact of the Nafis Scheme, challenges remain, such as the limited awareness among employers about the benefits of hiring Emirati nationals. Additionally, some businesses may struggle to find qualified Emiratis with the necessary skills for specific roles, leading to hesitancy in recruitment.

How Emiratisation Gateway Helps:

The Emiratisation Gateway addresses challenges faced by employees and employers. We provide resources and support to both parties. We offer:

  • Training programs
  • Job matching services, and
  • Awareness campaigns

In short, we help bridge the skills gap and promote the advantages of hiring Emiratis. It fosters a more inclusive job market.

Conclusion

The Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme is a UAE government promise. It improves the employment opportunities for Emirati nationals in the private sector. This approach provides financial incentives and support to employers. While making it an incentive for the private sector to continue hiring local talent. On the other hand, it also resolves critical issues like lack of skill and awareness among employers.

More Emiratis being employed contributes toward the broader goals of economic diversification and sustainability, therefore making for a more inclusive and robust jobs market in the country. Collaborative efforts from government entities, employers, as well as resources such as the Emiratisation Gateway, have good prospects in bringing long-lasting positive effects on the UAE’s economy and its workforce.
